biggest_catch: No official ReceiptPal/NPD Group page publishing exact, current payout terms was found — only third-party reviews document the 4-receipts=100-points / 2,200-points=$5 mechanism, and third-party sources are off-limits.
catches: The closest official-copy text is the provider-written App Store listing ('ReceiptPal lets you earn valuable gift cards and cash prizes, just for submitting receipts'), which names no conversion rate or minimum.
Third-party reviews describe: 4 receipts = 100 points; 2,200 points = $5 gift card (~6 cents/receipt); no cash payout; email must be connected 30 days — none of this is on an official provider page.
Official provider domains only: without official terms, the payout mechanism cannot be quoted and inferred compensation is forbidden.
